cands.bio: Democratic candidate for Alabama House District 37 in 2026. Business owner and president, and a partner in PolitiBox in Birmingham. Has volunteered with nonprofits using communication design skills. Holds a 1982 Auburn University bachelor's degree and a 2009 graduate degree from the University of the Arts London. Has held no elected office.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as recommended by the voter guides Tabitha's List (Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner) and Unburdening The Ballot (Sway voting group by Tevin Davis).

cands.gaps: We could not confirm her birthplace, where she was raised, or when she moved to Alabama; the only source says she is a "Roanoke native" without naming a state. We found no record of elected office or legislative, policy or budget work. We found no stated positions or actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, police and public order, gun laws, or abortion. We found no documented controversies and no foreign ties.

cands.bio: Retired fire chief and paramedic with over 45 years in public safety. Has served the Town of Five Points as councilmember and mayor for more than 20 years. Helps fire departments with grant writing. Republican; won the House District 37 seat in 2026.
cands.gaps: His birthplace is not stated on any page we read. We found no stated positions or official actions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no dates for his terms on the Five Points council or as mayor, and the site does not name his small business. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him.
